'''2015 European Championship Day 3 Marvin Tegeler LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Marvin Tegeler]] at [[2015 European Championship]] (Day 3).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2015-european-championships/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013125919/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2015-european-championships.html Internet Archive]
